import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModules
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TensorSectionFormula

/-!
# Multiplication of divisor modules

Multiplication of bounded rational functions induces the canonical morphism
`O(D) tensor O(E) -> O(D + E)` of structure-sheaf modules. The section formula
retains the actual multiplication map needed to compare local generators.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]

/-- Products of bounded sections satisfy the bound for the sum divisor. -/
lemma mul_mem_divisorSections {D E : X.CurveDivisor} {U : X.Opens}
    {s t : X.functionField} (hs : s ∈ divisorSections K D U)
    (ht : t ∈ divisorSections K E U) : s * t ∈ divisorSections K (D + E) U := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty
  · rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty K hU] at hs ht ⊢
    intro x hx hxU
    rw [map_mul, divisorBound_add]
    exact mul_le_mul' (hs x hx hxU) (ht x hx hxU)
  · rw [divisorSections_of_empty K hU, Submodule.mem_bot] at hs ⊢
    simp only [hs, zero_mul]

variable [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- Sectionwise multiplication of divisor modules is multiplication in the function field. -/
noncomputable def divisorSectionsProduct {D E : X.CurveDivisor} {U : X.Opens}
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    Γ(divisorModules K (D + E), U) :=
  ⟨divisorVal K s * divisorVal K t,
    mul_mem_divisorSections K (divisorVal_mem K s) (divisorVal_mem K t)⟩

@[simp]
lemma divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct {D E : X.CurveDivisor} {U : X.Opens}
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    divisorVal K (divisorSectionsProduct K s t) = divisorVal K s * divisorVal K t := rfl

lemma divisorSectionsProduct_smul_left {D E : X.CurveDivisor} {U : X.Opens}
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    divisorSectionsProduct K (r • s) t = r • divisorSectionsProduct K s t := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty
  · apply divisorSection_ext K
    change divisorVal K (divisorSectionsProduct K
        (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K D) le_rfl r s) t) =
      divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K (D + E))
        le_rfl r (divisorSectionsProduct K s t))
    rw [divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct,
      divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
      divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
      divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct, mul_assoc]
  · exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K (D + E) U)
      (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hU) _ _

lemma divisorSectionsProduct_smul_right {D E : X.CurveDivisor} {U : X.Opens}
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    divisorSectionsProduct K s (r • t) = r • divisorSectionsProduct K s t := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty
  · apply divisorSection_ext K
    change divisorVal K (divisorSectionsProduct K s
        (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K E) le_rfl r t)) =
      divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K (D + E))
        le_rfl r (divisorSectionsProduct K s t))
    rw [divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct,
      divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
      divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU),
      divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct, mul_left_comm]
  · exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K (D + E) U)
      (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hU) _ _

/-- The linear map from the sectionwise tensor product induced by multiplication. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesMulApp (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens) :
    (Modules.tensorPresheaf (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E)).obj (op U) ⟶
      (divisorModules K (D + E)).val.obj (op U) :=
  ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensorLift (divisorSectionsProduct K)
    (by
      intro s s' t
      apply divisorSection_ext K
      exact add_mul _ _ _)
    (divisorSectionsProduct_smul_left K)
    (by
      intro s t t'
      apply divisorSection_ext K
      exact mul_add _ _ _)
    (divisorSectionsProduct_smul_right K)

@[simp]
lemma divisorModulesMulApp_tmul (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    divisorModulesMulApp K D E U (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] t) =
      divisorSectionsProduct K s t := rfl

lemma divisorSectionsProduct_restrict {D E : X.CurveDivisor} {U V : X.Opens}
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    (divisorModules K (D + E)).val.map (homOfLE hVU).op (divisorSectionsProduct K s t) =
      divisorSectionsProduct K
        ((divisorModules K D).val.map (homOfLE hVU).op s)
        ((divisorModules K E).val.map (homOfLE hVU).op t) := by
  by_cases hV : (V : Set X).Nonempty
  · apply divisorSection_ext K
    change divisorVal K ((divisorPresheaf K (D + E)).map (homOfLE hVU).op
        (divisorSectionsProduct K s t)) =
      divisorVal K (divisorSectionsProduct K
        ((divisorPresheaf K D).map (homOfLE hVU).op s)
        ((divisorPresheaf K E).map (homOfLE hVU).op t))
    rw [divisorPresheaf_map_val K _ hV, divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct,
      divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct, divisorPresheaf_map_val K _ hV,
      divisorPresheaf_map_val K _ hV]
  · exact @Subsingleton.elim (divisorSections K (D + E) V)
      (divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty K hV) _ _

/-- Rational multiplication as a morphism from the presheaf tensor. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesMulPresheaf (D E : X.CurveDivisor) :
    Modules.tensorPresheaf (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) ⟶
      (divisorModules K (D + E)).val where
  app U := divisorModulesMulApp K D E U.unop
  naturality {U V} f := ModuleCat.MonoidalCategory.tensor_ext (fun s t => by
    change divisorModulesMulApp K D E V.unop
        ((Modules.tensorPresheaf (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E)).map f
          (s ⊗ₜ[X.presheaf.obj U] t)) =
      (divisorModules K (D + E)).val.map f (divisorModulesMulApp K D E U.unop
        (s ⊗ₜ[X.presheaf.obj U] t))
    change divisorSectionsProduct K ((divisorModules K D).val.map f s)
        ((divisorModules K E).val.map f t) =
      (divisorModules K (D + E)).val.map f (divisorSectionsProduct K s t)
    exact (divisorSectionsProduct_restrict K f.unop.le s t).symm)

/-- The canonical multiplication `O(D) tensor O(E) -> O(D + E)`. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesMul (D E : X.CurveDivisor) :
    Modules.tensorObj (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) ⟶
      divisorModules K (D + E) :=
  ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).homEquiv
    (Modules.tensorPresheaf (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E))
    (divisorModules K (D + E))).symm (divisorModulesMulPresheaf K D E)

/-- Composing the tensor-section comparison with multiplication recovers the section map. -/
lemma tensorSectionHom_comp_divisorModulesMul (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens) :
    Modules.tensorSectionHom (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) U ≫
        (divisorModulesMul K D E).val.app (op U) = divisorModulesMulApp K D E U := by
  have h := ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
    (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).homEquiv
    (Modules.tensorPresheaf (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E))
    (divisorModules K (D + E))).apply_symm_apply (divisorModulesMulPresheaf K D E)
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.app (op U)) h

/-- The tensor-sheaf multiplication restricts to multiplication on pure tensors of sections. -/
lemma divisorModulesMul_tensorSectionHom_tmul (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    (divisorModulesMul K D E).app U
        (Modules.tensorSectionHom (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) U
          (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] t)) = divisorSectionsProduct K s t :=
  congrArg (fun f => f (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] t))
    (tensorSectionHom_comp_divisorModulesMul K D E U)

/-- The canonical multiplication sends a pure tensor to the product of its rational values. -/
lemma divisorVal_divisorModulesMul_tmul (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) (t : Γ(divisorModules K E, U)) :
    divisorVal K ((divisorModulesMul K D E).app U
        (Modules.tensorSectionHom (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) U
          (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] t))) = divisorVal K s * divisorVal K t := by
  rw [divisorModulesMul_tensorSectionHom_tmul, divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct]

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
